'''Admiral_Sjet Hidden Base: Attack Of The Clones''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

* '''Player:''' [[Admiral_Sjet]]
* '''Published:''' 26 June 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]

* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 HB Admiral_Sjet LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

Basically a Big Space Beatdown, with some aded force drains.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Strat 1: Deploy Cheap X-Wings and Make Your Opponent Pay in Space. Kessel Is Your Big Force Drain System, so make sure you can hold it. Deploy the Required Number of Systems, and then Drain away.

Strat 2: Deploy the Modest Number of Characters in this deck to one or two mlocations to prevent certain actions from occuring: Dark Deal, Closed Door, Stuff Like That.

Strat 3: Prevent the Opponent from doing anything. With the Defensive Shields, It could be Worse, Systems will slip through your fingers, Honor of the Jedi and Rebel Fleet, you can prevent a lot of Damage to yourself.

Strat 4: Play All Wings Report In to retrieve that nice 10 force at the end of the game, adding insult to injury to their hopefully weakened deck.

Strat 5: Retrieval. There are a lot of cards in here which allow for retrieval of cards, or at least the blockage of major loss, such as Houjix and Out of Nowhere.
